In the realm of social media and digital culture, Rodriguez has supervised several projects. They also advised a 2024 qualitative analysis of how nano-influencers use Chibi Live2D models as a branding tool for social entertainment. Additionally, they supervised a 2024 mixed-methods study exploring romantic expressions in digital photography, which falls under arts and creative practice and journalism and news media.
